sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code: Open-Source Agentic Coding Model
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.7 Code is a coding-focused agentic model with improved long-horizon coding, stronger agent capabilities, and 30% lower thinking-token usage than K2.6.

sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code - Open-Source 1T Agentic Coding Model
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.7 Code by Moonshot AI: a 1-trillion-parameter open-source agentic coding model with 256K context, MCP tool use, native multimodality, benchmarks, pricing, download, API, GitHub and requirements.

sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code - Kimi API Platform
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.7 Code HighSpeed (kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed) is the high-speed version of Kimi K2.7 Code, the same model as Kimi K2.7 Code, but with an output speed of approximately 180 Tokens/s and up to 260 Tokens/s in short context scenarios, delivering a more extreme coding experience.

sources.title: Kimi K2.7 Code — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.7 Code is an open-source, coding-focused mixture-of-experts model with 1 trillion total parameters and 32 billion active parameters, designed for long-horizon software engineering tasks. The model supports text and image input, operates with a 256K context window, and includes thinking-mode reasoning that reduces token usage by approximately 30% compared to its predecessor K2.6.

sources.title: Kimi K2.7 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: Kimi K2.7 Code is a coding-focused agentic model built upon Kimi K2.6. With substantial improvements on real-world long-horizon coding tasks, it strengthens end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering workflows while improving token efficiency, reducing thinking-token usage by approximately 30% compared with Kimi K2.6.
